title: Commissioned measurement record, v0.1 (DRAFT — HELD for the owner's terms)
description: One commissioned piece of measurement work: who commissioned it, about which subject, which of the four offering kinds, how it is paid (per delivered work — x402 door or a GBP invoice; the amount never appears in this record), and the artifact-level disclosure the claim-maintenance spec requires (§10.3). A commission buys work, never a result: payment is never contingent on what is published (§10.2), a record never asserts falsity about anyone (§10.1), and nothing here is a grade, a score, a rank or a certificate. Not published: this schema is a draft until the owner rules on the terms and on self-commissioning.

kind.description: maintained_claim: a subject's public claim kept under the claim-maintenance spec for a term. reproduction_on_request: one published result re-run from its own inputs, the outcome recorded as found. underwriter_evidence_pack: already-signed cards about one subject assembled with inclusion proofs for a named reader. disclosure_timeline: the dated sequence of a subject's public statements and changes on one topic.

name.description: The legal entity that pays. Published on the artifact; a commission whose payer cannot be named is not accepted.

relationship_to_subject.description: IS_SUBJECT = self-commissioning (the owner rules whether it is offered at all; until then the guard refuses it). THIRD_PARTY_WITH_RELATIONSHIP requires the relationship to be named in conflicts[].

relationship.description: What the relationship is, when there is one (investor, customer, insurer, competitor, standards-body co-participant).

identifier.description: A stable id where one exists (model id, contract address, registry name).

basis.description: Paid per piece of work delivered. There is no subscription, no tier and no public price.

contingent_on_content.description: Spec §10.2: never contingent on what is published.

reference.description: The x402 settle transaction or the CSOAI LTD invoice reference. Never an amount.

conflicts.description: Spec §10.3, at the artifact level. Always names the commission itself ("Commissioned and paid for by <name>"), plus any relationship between CSOAI and the subject or the payer.

deliverable.description: What is handed over, in the words of the door or the scope letter.

states.description: The states the delivered artifact may carry. UNMEASURED is first-class; a commission never converts it into anything else.

never.description: What the commission can never buy.

contains.const: a grade, score, rank or certificate

owner_ruling.description: Present only after the owner rules (e.g. on self-commissioning). Absent means HELD.
